description: Turn a recording into text with FreeTTS speech to text (PRO). Give the audio as a file the user attached (audio_file) or a public https link to the file (audio_url): mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac, aac, webm, or a video file. Up to 200 MB and the plan's length per recording (PRO: 4 hours). Optional: speakers (label who speaks), timestamps (a time on every line), subtitles ('srt' or 'vtt' file). A long recording may answer with a job_id instead of the text: then call get_transcript with it.

audio_file.description: A file the user attached in the chat.

download_url.description: Temporary download address of the file.

mime_type.description: Type of the file, like audio/mpeg.

audio_url.description: Public https URL of the audio file.

language.description: Language of the recording, like 'en-US', 'de-DE', 'Arabic' or 'es', or 'auto' to detect it (default). Naming it is more accurate.

speakers.description: Label who is speaking (Speaker 1, Speaker 2, up to 6). Default false.

subtitles.description: Also make a subtitle file in this format and return its link.

timestamps.description: Start each line with its time, like [01:15]. Default false.

name: transcribe_audio

complete.description: false when text holds only the first part; the whole text is at transcript_url.

expected_seconds.description: About how long until the transcript is ready.

job_id.description: Pass to get_transcript while status is working.

status.description: working: a long recording is still being transcribed; collect it with get_transcript.

subtitles.description: The subtitle file, kept one day.

download_url.description: Where the file can be downloaded.

file_name.description: A name for the file, made from its first words.

text.description: The transcript (with times or speakers when asked). For a very long one, the first part.

transcript_url.description: The whole transcript as a text file, kept one day.

title: Transcribe audio (speech to text)
